Bill.BriefDescription: Creating an extended authority commission for Washington state patrol officers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the creation of an extended authority commissionfor Washington state patrol officers; and adding a new section tochapter 43.43 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.43 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Washington state patrol officers may request that an extendedauthority commission be granted by the chief of the Washington statepatrol. (2) State patrol officers who desire an extended authoritycommission shall request and complete an extended authority commissionpacket and satisfy the following requirements: (a) Acquire a Washington stateapproved first aid certificationcard valid through the year of extended authority; (b) Qualify with their firearm in accordance with Washington statepatrol rules or guidelines; (c) Must be under the age limit specified in RCW 43.43.250; and (d) Pay a fee of fifty dollars to the Washington state patrol. p. 1 SB 6631 (3) If the state patrol officer satisfies the requirements undersubsection (2) of this section, the Washington state patrol shallphotograph the officer and issue him or her a Washington state patrolcommission card that will expire January 15th of the following year.However, an officer may renew his or her state patrol commission cardin accordance with Washington state patrol rules or guidelines. (4) A state patrol officer, who is granted extended authority bythe chief of the Washington state patrol, may be issued a badge set,gun, and handcuffs, and any additional uniform requirements, if theofficer pays a cash deposit equal to the value of the equipmentselected or a sum determined by the Washington state patrol. TheWashington state patrol shall refund any cash deposit in full uponreturn of the equipment in good condition. (5) A state patrol officer must provide proof of liabilityinsurance issued for and paid entirely by the officer within one monthafter being granted extended authority commission. (6) The chief of the Washington state patrol may revoke the grantof extended authority commission for any reason.
